summary: Morris Knob lookout tower, built in Tazewell County, now stands at the Matthews State Forest office in Grayson County, Virginia; NHLR-registered 2017. Build and move dates not found.

visit.trail_note: All trails south of Route 58 close for hunting every day except Sunday, from the first Saturday in October through the first Saturday in January. The forest office is at 106 Forestry Lane, Galax; phone (276) 236-2322, listed for reserving facilities.

events.note: Registered January 23, 2017 as US 1161, VA 27; nominated by Kristin Reynolds

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the register and the forestry page were read. The register is the sole source that the tower stands at the forest office; the forestry page does not mention the tower (checked: no tower, lookout, or move wording on that page). Build date, builder and move date are not in any source read, so no relocated event is recorded (events need a year). The forestry page says the forest is operated by VDOF and lists the office, but gives no visiting rules for the tower, so no access level is recorded. The phone number is on the forestry page only, for reserving facilities; the register does not give it, so the story cites it to the forestry page alone and asks readers to call ahead about the tower. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia lists give the Matthews entry as standing and the original Morris Knob site as gone; those lists were not quoted here, so the 'standing' status rests on the register's present-tense description. Original site record us-va-morris-knob is marked relocated, which fits. Editor could confirm the tower's condition and visitor access by phoning the forest office. No corrections proposed.
